segments.text: Once you have completed your work, you will need to decontaminate all of the materials inside of the BSC and the BSC itself.
segments.zh: 完成工作后，你需要对生物安全柜内的所有材料以及生物安全柜本身进行去污。

segments.text: This is all done while the blower motor is on.
segments.zh: 这些都要在风机开着的情况下进行。

segments.text: The first thing that needs to be done is close all the containers.
segments.zh: 首先要做的是盖好所有容器。

segments.text: Next, using the same disinfectant used to clean the cabinet before work started, generously apply disinfectant to the materials in the cabinet.
segments.zh: 接下来，使用工作开始前清洁安全柜时所用的同一种消毒剂，充分地涂抹在柜内的材料上。

segments.text: This can be done directly to the materials or by moistening a towel and wiping the surface of the materials, starting with the least contaminated items first.
segments.zh: 可以直接涂在材料上，也可以润湿一张纸巾擦拭材料表面，先从污染最轻的物品开始。

segments.text: Please note, samples should be surface decontaminated or placed into secondary containers that have been surface decontaminated prior to exiting the cabinet.
segments.zh: 请注意，样品在移出安全柜之前，应进行表面去污，或者放入已经过表面去污的二级容器中。

segments.text: Please allow materials to remain wetted for the appropriate amount of contact time.
segments.zh: 请让材料保持湿润，达到适当的接触时间。

segments.text: After the appropriate contact time is passed, remove any residual wetness and place the materials that will remain in the cabinet on the designated clean side of the cabinet.
segments.zh: 经过适当的接触时间后，擦去残留的水分，把要留在柜内的材料放到柜内指定的清洁侧。

segments.text: If a blue absorbent pad was used, discard it into the biohazardous waste container by grabbing the outer corners of the pad and folding it inward.
segments.zh: 如果使用了蓝色吸水垫，抓住吸水垫的外角向内折叠，把它丢进生物危害废物容器。

segments.text: Other materials from the BSC, placing them on your cart.
segments.zh: 把生物安全柜中的其他材料取出，放到你的推车上。

segments.text: After removing everything from the cabinet that needs to come out, proceed to decontaminate the inner surfaces of the BSC as you did before beginning work.
segments.zh: 把柜内需要拿出来的东西全部取出后，像开始工作前那样，对生物安全柜的内表面进行去污。

segments.text: Don't forget the sides and back wall as well as the inside of the glass sash.
segments.zh: 别忘了侧壁和后壁，以及玻璃前窗的内侧。

segments.text: To remove the biohazardous waste bag or container, moisten a paper towel with disinfectant and carefully wipe the outside of the bag and or waste pan.
segments.zh: 要取出生物危害废物袋或容器时，用消毒剂润湿一张纸巾，小心地擦拭废物袋和／或废物盘的外表面。

segments.text: Dispose of the paper towels and gloves. Allow for the appropriate amount of contact time.
segments.zh: 丢弃纸巾和手套。留出适当的接触时间。

segments.text: Next, add the recommended amount of water to the biohazard bag and then loosely gather the opening of the biohazard bag and loosely tape it.
segments.zh: 接下来，往生物危害废物袋中加入建议量的水，然后把袋口松松地收拢，用胶带松松地封上。

segments.text: The reason you loosely closed it is because you don't want it completely sealed when it goes into the autoclave.
segments.zh: 之所以要松松地封口，是因为放进高压灭菌器时，你不希望它是完全密封的。

segments.text: If it is, then the steam will not be able to penetrate the bag and the contents may not be decontaminated.
segments.zh: 如果完全密封，蒸汽就无法穿透袋子，里面的东西可能就无法被去污。

segments.text: If only a biohazard bag was used, remove the bag and place it into a waste pan outside of the BSC for autoclaving.
segments.zh: 如果只用了生物危害废物袋，就把袋子取出，放到生物安全柜外的废物盘中进行高压灭菌。

segments.text: If a bag and a waste pan were used, remove both from the BSC.
segments.zh: 如果同时用了废物袋和废物盘，就把两者都从生物安全柜中取出。

segments.text: Leave the blower motor running for at least four more minutes to purge the air.
segments.zh: 让风机再运行至少四分钟，以清除空气中的污染物。

segments.text: After four minutes, turn off the lights and blower and close the sash.
segments.zh: 四分钟后，关闭照明灯和风机，并关上前窗。

segments.text: If you have a UV light, you may or may not turn it on, as per your SOPs.
segments.zh: 如果有紫外灯，可以根据你们的 SOP 决定是否打开。

segments.text: Some labs will leave their BSC blower motor running continuously.
segments.zh: 有些实验室会让生物安全柜的风机一直运行。

segments.text: In that case, you could turn off the light but leave the sash open.
segments.zh: 这种情况下，你可以关掉照明灯，但让前窗保持打开。

segments.text: If your lab keeps a usage log, be sure to sign the BSC log form.
segments.zh: 如果你们实验室有使用记录，一定要在生物安全柜使用记录表上签名。

segments.text: One final note.
segments.zh: 最后再说一点。

segments.text: Each lab should have established schedules and SOPs for routine cleaning
segments.zh: 每个实验室都应制定日常清洁的时间安排和 SOP，

segments.text: and any routine maintenance not requiring an outside contractor.
segments.zh: 以及不需要外部承包商的日常维护的时间安排和 SOP。

segments.text: Non-routine maintenance repairs will be handled by a contractor designated by the safety office.
segments.zh: 非日常的维护维修将由安全办公室指定的承包商负责。

segments.text: Laboratory staff members should be aware of their responsibilities and establish policies necessary to maintain the BSCs.
segments.zh: 实验室工作人员应了解自己的职责，并制定维护生物安全柜所需的制度。

segments.text: And they should consult the safety office for any needed guidance.
segments.zh: 如需任何指导，应咨询安全办公室。
